constraints:
# Preliminary internal-clock constraints from design book §11.2.
# NOT a sign-off IO/STA file: no target board, pinout, source/sink clocks,
# device implementation project or timing netlist is supplied. In §11.2,
# nominal 3.2 ns IO delays are explicitly a commented *example*, not a
# measured board budget. Do not enable made-up IO delays for a PASS verdict.
create_clock -name clk -period 8.000 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_uncertainty 0.45 [get_clocks clk]
set_clock_transition 0.30 [get_clocks clk]
set_false_path -from [get_ports pps_in]
note: Internal-clock preliminary only; no invented board IO delays
